integrity: The central convergence is proved with explicit stationary-age coupling and a compact-time grid bound; numerical examples are supporting checks only.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive flip rate and forcing, stationary velocity-orientation initialization, independent Poisson velocity-only resets and smooth monotone confining drag; general nonlinear infinite-observation-time diffusivity limit and orientation resetting are not asserted. The full text of one broad partial-resetting reference could not be inspected.
title: Strong velocity resetting separates Laplace velocities from telegraph transport
